Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 31 Unwins Bridge Road.pdf

Clause 9.31.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and 
encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.31.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified  Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.31.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly s ingle storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.31.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original form including 
roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.31.2 - other (development_control): To protect  significant streetscapes  and/or public domain elements withi n the 
precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and 
guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.31.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low density residen tial character of the precinct.

Clause 9.31.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off -street car parking does not 
adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.31.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified values of the Collins Street Heritage Conservation Area.
